tickets.title: Ticket Board: Channels, team membership and message delivery API
tickets.body: Queued assignment claude-opus, after current work. Repo advitiyavashist/tickets, separate worktree. Read docs/messages-and-runners.md and docs/messages.html in ../tickets-design. tickets.title: Ticket Board: Managed Claude runner wakes on task messages
tickets.body: Queued assignment claude-sonnet, after current work. Repo advitiyavashist/tickets, separate worktree. Read docs/messages-and-runners.md and docs/messages.html in ../tickets-design. Own src/ticket_board/runners/, tests/runners/. Acceptance: Supervisor outlives model turns; authenticated wake queue; explicit session ownership and worktree; claude programmatic resume with stdin input. Atomic task claim, busy queue, reconnect, fenced lease, crash reconciliation, bounded retries/budgets, normal permissions and approval state. No reply loops. Healthy idle start target <=5s, measured. Submit exact SHA, checks and handoff to cursor; no self-close.

tickets.title: Ticket Board: Verify real message-to-task execution and team isolation
tickets.body: Queued assignment cursor-2, after current work. Repo advitiyavashist/tickets, separate worktree. Read docs/messages-and-runners.md and docs/messages.html in ../tickets-design. Own tests/acceptance/messaging/, docs/runbook.md. Acceptance: Real disposable managed Claude DM -> claim -> run -> reply proof; channel master routing; duplicate and crash replay, busy/offline, interactive-session collision, permission request, revoked/unauthorized send, dependency block, reply-loop limit, cancel and budgets. Confirm human messages alone do not fan out to all agents. Submit exact SHA, checks and handoff to cursor; no self-close.
